newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB says Chapman new group chairman.
newsitem.headline: FNB says Chapman new group chairman.

text.p: First National Bank Holdings Ltd on Monday announced the appointment of Neal Chapman as the group's new chairman with immediate effect.
FNB said in a statement Chapman had taken over from previous chairman Basil Hersov who had retired after 14 years in the position.
Prior to the appointment Chapman was FNB vice-chairman and he is currently Southern Life Association Ltd chairman.

He is also a director of Anglo American Corporation of SA Ltd, Palabora Mining Company Ltd, Telkom SA Ltd, Alliance Capital Southern Africa Fund, Oceana Fishing Group Ltd and the National Business Initiative.
